scope: Explicitly reviewed ordinary California residential-security and screening-fee duties only. No blanket change to property-wide exemptions, remedies, special-class benefits, route-specific permissions, or reduced allowances.
interpretation: In coverage mode, report a governing conditional residential-rental duty independently of whether a particular security payment, screening payment, vacancy, deduction, inspection or delivery has happened. Preserve complete original coverage predicates in the event trigger, and preserve every transaction-specific exception and source question at the event stage. This aligns these records with the existing reviewed cap, 21-day accounting and alternative screening-process plans. An applies result is not a finding that a specific event or breach occurred.
